# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled graphics engine to Skia m154. This preview starts the 4.154 line with the current upstream renderer. Review the HarfBuzzSharp compatibility changes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132** — The misspelled `CCC133` member is replaced by the upstream-correct `CCC132` name while retaining numeric value 132. Update source references to the corrected member name.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer available** — The aggregate `GlyphFlags.Defined` mask is removed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled graphics engine with Chrome milestone 154, bringing the latest upstream rendering work to the 4.154 preview line. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
